text:
The bugs were fixed as follows:

1.  **`unique(items)`**: The original implementation used `list(set(items))`, which does not preserve the order of appearance. It was changed to use a `seen` set while iterating through the items to build a list, ensuring it preserves the first occurrence of each element.
2.  **`partition(items, pred)`**: The original implementation returned `no, yes` (failing elements first), but the tests expected `yes, no` (matching elements first). I swapped the return order to `yes, no`.
3.  **`windows(items, k)`**: The range in the list comprehension was missing the final window because it used `len(items) - k`. It was corrected to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)`, which includes the final sliding window of size $k$.

All 10 tests now pass.
